behaviors.description: Select the independently configured repair root among competing stores.
behaviors.preconditions: Disposable default, named and user installations with distinct sentinel remotes.
behaviors.expected: Each dry run identifies only the selected installation path, preserves all remotes and deployments, and rejects an unknown named installation.

mappings.rationale: Public repair output must name the independently configured selected root and omit the competing roots. This is selection evidence, not a new corruption-recovery claim.

surface_assertions.rationale: User repair selects the user root rather than the default or named system root.
Named repair selects the configured alternate root and an absent name cannot fall back.
